To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Zn2−2Cu2SiO4 is a solid solution that is stable in a wide temperature range, and that it has a willemite structure with a tetragonal symmetry of the I4̄1/a space group.
the solid solution Zn2−xCu2xSiO2 with willemite structure can be synthesized by solid-phase synthesis at 1030 ±1°C and the maximum extent of the solid solution is 0.075.
the maximum anneal temperature is 1031°C, the extent of solid solution is 0.075, and the melting points of Zn2SiO 4 and Zn2CuSiO4 are 1512°C and 1511°C, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis and characterization of Zn2−xCuxSiO4 solid solutions with the willemites structure, the study of phase equilibria in the ZnO−CuO−SiO 2 system, and the development of the method of triangulation of phase diagrams.
the synthesis and thermal properties of solid solution Zn2−xCu2xO with a willemite structure.

the synthesis of the Zn2SiO3−Cu2SiO3 solid solution, the determination of its homogeneity region, the crystal-chemical parameters of the solid solution, the coefficients of thermal linear expansion and the determination of the melting points of Zn2SiO2.5−Cu2Si2.5O4.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the solid solution of Zn2SiO 4 by copper oxide has the willemite crystal structure, the extent of the homogeneity region is 7.6 ± 0.1 at % Cu and the solid solution is thermally stable.
the solid-phase synthesis of Zn2− 2xCu2+ xSiO4 is a promising way to obtain new materials with the willemitesi structure and a wide range of applications.
the solid solution Zn2−xCu2xSiO2 with the willemites structure is a promising material for the production of optical fibers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Zn2−Cu2+ solid solutions with the willemitem structure are promising materials for the manufacture of transparent ceramics.

the proposed synthesis procedure for Zn2−2xM2xSiO 4 solid solutions with the willemites structure is simple, reproducible and allows the formation of a wide range of solid solutions with a maximum dopant concentration x = 0.075.
the proposed solid-phase method is a promising approach for the synthesis of solid solutions of the Zn2SiO3−Zn2CuSiO4−Zn2SiO4 system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Zn2−xMxSiO4 willemite-type solid solutions are promising for the production of new materials with a high thermal stability and low thermal expansion coefficient.
the proposed synthesis method allows one to obtain the solid solution Zn2−xZnxSiO4 with a wide range of dopant index x (up to 7.5) and a high level of homogeneity.
the ZnO−CuO−SiO 2 system is a promising one for the synthesis of solid solution phosphors with willemite structure.
